mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte derangements (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair valbenazine metabolism and increase CNS adverse effects; both drugs have potential for QT prolongation.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and QTc interval closely; ensure aggressive hydration and electrolyte supplementation during amphotericin B therapy; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of valbenazine metabolites if available.
